component.name: Gambit
component.summary: Play chess against the computer or a friend

description.p: Gambit is chess made for Luma: a calm board that fits a phone, a tablet and a desktop, and an opponent that plays at your level, from your first game to grandmaster.

ul.li: Play the computer at five levels, with a hint whenever you are stuck
Play a friend on the same device
Solve puzzles from real games, picked near your level, with a rating that follows you
Tap or drag the pieces, or play with the keyboard alone
See the opening's name as you play, and a review of every finished game
Undo a move, see every move of the game, and pick up where you left off

description.p: The opponent is Stockfish, running on your device. Gambit needs no account and no connection.

screenshot.caption: Play the computer at five levels, with the opening named as you go
Puzzles from real games, picked near your level
A review of every finished game: accuracy and the key moments
The same app on a phone

description.p: The first release: play the computer at five levels or a friend on the same device, and solve puzzles from the Lichess puzzle database.
